sentences.text: The current UCB directions say that existing floating-rate term loans sanctioned before 31 December 2025 for non-business individual borrowers are not chargeable, but that wording does not cover a loan sanctioned on 31 December 2025 itself.
The separate rule for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026 also says a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on floating-rate loans to individuals for purposes other than business.
So the cited directions do not support levying pre-payment charges on this loan, and the 31 December 2025 sanction-date edge case is not expressly covered.

missing.slot: Sanction-date treatment for a floating-rate non-business individual home loan sanctioned exactly on 31 December 2025
missing.searched: Checked the current UCB pre-payment-charge directions for the before-31-Dec-2025 rule and the on-or-after-1-Jan-2026 rule; neither expressly states the treatment for loans sanctioned on 31 December 2025.
